xref.title: CBL & Orion Tribute to Cliff Burton
xref.body: Above his right elbow, James has the letters "CBL," which are the initials of former Metallica bassist Cliff Burton. Under his inner left arm, there are musical notes that transcribe the song "Orion," a track written by Cliff Burton, serving as a tribute to him after his death in a 1986 tour bus accident. "Just above his right elbow are the letters CBL. Then there were some musical notes under his inner left arm. That's a transcription of the song Orion, which is in tribute to former Metallica bass player Cliff Burton, who died in a tour bus accident in 1986."
